<!--
Adapt this template to the change. Headings are optional: a simple fix may need only a sentence or two. Delete unused sections and these comments before submitting. Write for a reviewer who has not followed the issue or discussion.
-->

## Problem

<!--
What is wrong or missing, and why does it need changing? Link the related issue where available. For a bug, include a minimal reproduction or a concrete example of the observed and expected behaviour. Keep supporting evidence brief and remove credentials and private Sentry data.
-->

## Proposed change

<!--
Explain the resulting behaviour and how it addresses the problem. Describe the reasoning a reviewer needs, rather than listing files or recounting the work.
-->

## Scope and trade-offs

<!--
Use this section only when it helps explain the boundaries or an important trade-off. Keep the PR focused on one problem; submit unrelated refactoring, formatting or features separately. Avoid restating details already clear above.
-->
